Cells can be isolated from tissue (see A for an example) or from cultured cells (see B for an example), the quantities specified in this protocol are for 2*10^7 cells. Troubleshooting: If obtaining a single-cell suspension proves difficult, see Troubleshooting 1. A) Harvesting mouse fetal liver cells (i)Harvest embryos at E14.5 and remove the dark red liver, remove all lightly colored tissue (ii) Gather the livers from the entire litter in 10 mL PBS and keep on ice. (iii) Use a P1000 pipet to dissociate livers by pipetting up and down. Place a 40 𝜇m cell strainer (Greiner bio-one cat. Nr 542040) on a 50 mL falcon tube, and transfer dissociated liver suspension onto the membrane. Pipet the livers up and down while the suspension is kept on the membrane, single cells will pass through the membrane. If large chunks remain, use the plunger of a 5mL syringe to press the chunks through the membrane. (iv) Spin down the single cell suspension at 500g for 10 minutes at 4˚C in a swing-
out centrifuge, discard supernatant and resuspend in 5mL 10%FBS/PBS. Count cells using a counting window or a cell-counter system and proceed with 2*10^7 cells (per batch). B) Harvesting K562 cells for MC-4C (i) Grow cells in suspension, count cells and pool ~2*10^7 cells into a 50 mL falcon tube (per batch). (ii) centrifuge cells at 500g for 10 minutes at room temperature in a swing-out centrifuge, discard supernatant and take up cells in 5 mL 10% FBS/PBS.

steps.title: Design and Validate gRNAs
steps.instruction: Design three gRNAs for each viewpoint: one between the inverse PCR primers and one in each of the two flanking DpnII restriction fragments.

substeps.instruction: Use the ATUM gRNA design tool (wild-type Cas9) to select gRNAs with the highest scores and perform BLAST for off-targets.
Design a qPCR primer set overlapping the Cas9 cut-site to verify digestion efficiency.
Order DNA oligonucleotides with the sequence: 5’-AAGCTAATACGACTCACTATAGG-gRNA-GTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAG (omit the last G of the T7 promoter if the gRNA starts with G).

Perform gRNA template PCR using Q5 high fidelity polymerase with a universal reverse primer (5’AAAAGCACCGACTCGGTGCCACTTTTTCAAGTTGATAACGGACTAGCCT TATTTTAACTTGCTATTTCTAGCTCTAAAAC) and gRNA specific primer.
Run PCR program: 98°C for 30s; 35x (98°C for 10s, 57°C for 10s, 72°C for 10s); 72°C for 5 min.
Perform in vitro transcription, purify gRNAs, and validate digestion efficiency via qPCR on genomic DNA or MC-4C template.

steps.title: Crosslink and First Digestion
steps.instruction: Crosslink cells and perform the initial restriction enzyme digestion.

substeps.instruction: Crosslink single-cell suspension by adding 5 mL of 4% formaldehyde in 10% FBS/PBS; incubate 10 minutes at room temperature on a rollerbank.
Quench by adding 1.425 mL of 1 M glycine; cool to 4°C and centrifuge 10 minutes at 500g in a swing-out centrifuge.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL cold lysis buffer (50 mM Tris pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 5 mM EDTA, 0.5% NP-40, 0.1% Triton); incubate 15 minutes on ice.
Centrifuge 10 minutes at 500g at 4°C, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 500 µL 1.1x DpnII buffer.
Warm sample to 37°C, add 15 µL 10% SDS, and incubate 1h at 37°C while shaking at 600 rpm.
Add 75 µL 20% Triton and incubate 1h at 37°C while shaking at 600 rpm.
Store 10 µL as undigested control ('U').
Add 200 units DpnII restriction enzyme and incubate ~3h at 37°C while shaking at 600 rpm (may be done in multiple batches).
Add another 200 units DpnII and incubate overnight at 37°C while shaking at 600 rpm.

steps.title: Digestion Control and First Ligation
steps.instruction: Verify digestion efficiency and perform the first proximity ligation.

substeps.instruction: Store 10 µL as digestion control ('D').
To 'U' and 'D' controls, add 80 µL 10mM Tris pH 7.5 and 10 µL 10 µg/µL Proteinase K; incubate 1h at 65°C and run 20 µL on 0.6% agarose gel.
Set up ligation reaction with final DNA concentration of 5ng/µL (e.g., for 50µg template: 1 mL 10x ligation buffer, 8.6mL milliQ, 20 µL T4 ligase).
Incubate overnight at 16°C.

steps.title: Template Purification and Cas9 Digestion
steps.instruction: Purify the ligation products and use Cas9 to remove non-informative fragments.

substeps.instruction: Perform Nucleomag PCR bead purification: add 1 sample volume isopropanol and 1:100 sample volume beads; incubate 30 min on rollerbank.
Use magnetic separator to clear solution; wash twice with 20 mL 80% ethanol.
Resuspend beads in 500 µL 10 mM Tris pH 7.5 or RNAse free water; incubate 10 min at 50°C while shaking at 700 RPM.
Perform 0.6x AMPure XP cleanup: add 0.6X volume beads, incubate 5 min at RT, wash twice with 500 µL 80% ethanol, and elute in 500 µL 10 mM tris pH 7.5 (elute at 50°C if yield is critical).
Perform in vitro Cas9 digestion using the designed gRNAs to cut the target fragment and its two neighboring fragments.

steps.title: Viewpoint Specific PCR and Purification
steps.instruction: Amplify the target concatemers using inverse PCR.

substeps.instruction: Perform 96 PCRs per viewpoint using PhireII hotstart polymerase and specific inverse primers (>50bp from DpnII sites).
Reaction mix (per PCR): 5 µL 5x phire buffer, 0.5 µL 10 mM DNTP, 2.5 µL 5uM primer mix, 0.5 µL Polymerase, 100 ng template, and MQ up to 25 µL.
PCR Program: 98°C for 20"; 30x (98°C for 10", 57°C for 20", 72°C for 1'30"); 72°C for 5'.
Pool all 96 reactions, take a 500 µL aliquot, and perform 0.6x AMPure XP purification; elute in 75µL TE.
Verify product on 0.6% agarose gel; expect a smear with fragments >1.5Kb.

steps.title: Size Selection and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Select the appropriate fragment size and sequence using long-read technology.

substeps.instruction: Perform Pippin size selection (e.g., Pippin HT HTC1510) with a range between 1.5 and 8 Kb on a 1.5% cassette.
Perform Nanopore library prep (SQK-LSK109 1D genomic DNA by ligation protocol), omitting DNA shearing and adjusting volume for input quantity.

steps.title: Data Processing and Analysis
steps.instruction: Process raw reads through the MC-4C pipeline to identify multi-way interactions.

substeps.instruction: Run 'setReadIds' to assign unique identifiers to reads.
Run 'splitReads' to split reads into fragments based on restriction sequences.
Run 'mapFragments' to map fragments to the reference genome using BWA.
Run 'makeDataset' to create an HDF5 dataset by extending fragments to nearest restriction sites.
Run 'removeDuplicates' to filter PCR duplicates using trans-ligations and far-cis fragments as UMIs.
Perform Quality Control (QC) using 'readSizeDist', 'cirSizeDist', 'chrCvg', 'overallProfile', and 'seqSaturation'.
Perform multi-contact analysis using 'atVpSoi' (single SOI), 'atSOISOI' (pair of SOIs), or 'atAcrossROI' (ROI-wide).
